idea-plugin.name: GuydAI Theme
idea-plugin.description:
GuydAI Theme — Cyber Ice

A dark PyCharm / IntelliJ theme with a cyber edge: pure-black chrome, electric-blue lead accents, and hot-pink pops — wrapped around a navy editor with warm gold syntax.

Ships as independent layers:

  • IDE chrome — "Cyber Ice" — pure-black toolbars, tabs, tool windows and popups, with electric-blue (buttons, active-tab underline, focus, caret) and hot-pink (badges, completion-match, link hover, bookmarks) accents.
  • Editor color scheme — "GuydAI" — navy #0a0e1a background with gold keywords, blue functions, green strings and purple numbers.
  • Editor color scheme — "GuydAI Pure Black" — same palette, near-black #030507 background for OLED / max-contrast setups.

Activate: Settings → Appearance & Behavior → Appearance → Theme → GuydAI. The default "GuydAI" editor scheme is applied automatically — switch to "GuydAI Pure Black" under Settings → Editor → Color Scheme.

Source & downloads: github.com/GuydAI/guydai-theme

Built by guydai.com — an AI system that watches the market 24/7, scores every opportunity, and can trade for you.
